ariaSpec.usage: Announces the radio type of the input.
The input requires an accessible name to which it will be assigned.
Boolean attribute that announces the checked state of the radio button.
Points to the hint or error message for the radio.
Rendered only when the radio input is disabled.
Rendered only when the radio button is in a form and announces the invalid state.

kbSpec.behavior: Moves focus to the previous button and selects it. If the first button is focused, moves focus to the last.
Moves the focus to the next button and selects it. If the last button is focused, moves the focus to the first one.
